name: FIRE_FIGHTER_2.0_WebGL
author: TheGandaIf
description: Modernise classic; "FIRE FIGHTER" was made 1982 for Atari 2600 console. It had unique consept: having the player save people and property rather than detroy them. The diversifyer of "Fire Fighter 2.0" is Sustainability. In the game you save animals, trees, nature and the world. It is important to remind people about global warming (which causes more and more forest fires (California, Australia, China...). No animals or trees has been harmed during this game coding. Join the movement, play and share the game! (spacebar: throw the water. Arrows: move. Mouse: buttons)
